goal.hint: A goal is the reason a stretch of work exists. It holds the habits and tasks that serve it, the checkpoints along the way, and a recurring check-in. It never hides anything.

routine.hint: A routine is a set of things you do regularly, in order, like a morning or a workout week. Pause it and they all step off your day together.

season.hint: A season is a stretch of life (a summer, a term, a training block) that switches whole routines on and off. Without dates it starts always-on, hiding nothing.

project.hint: Projects file your tasks, and can carry a repeating block on the grid.

tables.changedElsewhere: It changed on another device. Showing the latest.
